evidence.decision: Chooses segmented ancestry versus compact pop-up, separately deciding display versus editable location selection and valid dropped destinations.
evidence.artifact: Requires a location/segment/drop specification or implementation with editability, navigation, selection and validation behavior.
evidence.transformation: Export breadcrumb example moves a misleading toolbar control into the body and adds selected folder, hierarchy, Choose and supported folder drops.
evidence.verification: Exercises root/deep paths, narrow width, Choose/drop selection and stale locations, failing disagreement between displayed and actual destination.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly limits the component to Mac and separates desired validation from native filesystem permissions and drag evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Loads file-management for persistence/location work and drag-and-drop for actual transfer semantics rather than treating those as mandatory.
evidence.distinctiveness: Location identity, collapsed ancestry, body placement and editable drop/Choose behavior form a specific path-control operating contract.
